about: 3D chess backlog tickets mapped to eng courses. Each lesson assigns one ticket as its 'rep'. Division of labor (learner's rule, 2026-10-07): the learner does the staff-level work for the ticket (design doc, ADR, acceptance criteria, decision, PR review and merge, or the code itself when the lesson's skill IS the code: C, C++, CUDA); Claude writes the rest of the code as a PR for the learner to review. Re-check each ticket's state on GitHub before assigning it. state: open | assigned | shipped | skipped | proposed (not filed yet: ask before filing). When a ticket is assigned, set state 'assigned' and 'assigned_on' (YYYY-MM-DD); when shipped, 'shipped_on' and 'evidence' (PR/doc URL). Platform items (repo 'learning') aren't GitHub issues; they live only here, so no filing is needed.
